company: Community Health Plan of Imperial Valley
title: Health Plan Quality Director
text:
Community Health Plan of Imperial Valley (CHPIV) is Imperial County's Medi-Cal managed care plan. We are a locally managed public health care plan committed to working with members, providers, and the residents of Imperial County.

As we continue to build something great, we are looking for a Quality Director to be responsible for the strategic development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of CHPIV's Quality Improvement Program and Performance Improvement initiatives.

**Our next team member will do the following:**

* Direct and oversee CHPIV's Quality Improvement Program and related performance improvement activities.
* Collaborate with the Chief Medical Officer and Health Equity Officer to establish organizational quality and health equity goals, priorities, and strategies.
* Lead initiatives designed to improve clinical outcomes, member experience, preventive health measures, access to care, and care coordination.
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality improvement and health equity work plans.
* Monitor organizational performance measures and identify opportunities for improvement in quality, health outcomes, and equitable access to services.
* Partner with clinical and operational departments to reduce health disparities and improve outcomes among underserved and vulnerable populations.
* Support initiatives addressing social determinants of health, cultural and linguistic needs, and barriers to healthcare access.
* Coordinate quality studies, performance improvement projects, corrective action plans, and follow-up monitoring activities.
* Facilitate Quality Improvement Committee meetings and other quality-related workgroups.
* Develop executive summaries, committee reports, dashboards, presentations, and Board reports regarding quality and health equity performance.
* Support readiness activities and responses related to CMS, DHCS, DMHC, NCQA, and other regulatory requirements.
* Partner with delegated entities, providers, community organizations, and internal stakeholders to improve quality and member outcomes.
* Develop, review, and maintain quality management plans, policies, procedures, annual evaluations, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor project timelines, implementation activities, risks, and barriers to successful program execution.
* Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management for assigned staff.
* Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement, accountability, innovation, and health equity.

**You may be right for this job if you have the following:**

* Five (5) years of experience in managed care, healthcare quality, utilization management, care management, population health, compliance, clinical operations, or related healthcare programs.
* Two (2) or more years of program, project, or operational leadership experience supporting quality, regulatory, performance improvement, or healthcare initiatives.
* Three (3) years of progressive leadership, management, or supervisory experience.
* Experience leading quality improvement, clinical operations, regulatory compliance, accreditation, or performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.
* Experience collaborating with physicians, healthcare providers, executive leadership, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience developing policies, procedures, reports, presentations, and organizational work plans.
* Experience working within a managed care or healthcare delivery environment.
* Experience analyzing quality, clinical, operational, or regulatory performance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Knowledge of healthcare quality programs, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements, including CMS, DHCS, DMHC, and NCQA.
* Experience developing and implementing policies, procedures, corrective action plans, quality initiatives, and operational improvement strategies.
* Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, executive leadership, providers, health equity leaders, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

**Our commitment to you:**

* A competitive salary of $130,000-$160,000/ year
* Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your family covered 85%
* Generous paid time off
* A retirement plan with a generous match
* A chance to make a real difference in the Imperial Valley community

Preference will be given to candidates who are local to Imperial, California, but remote candidates living in California will also be considered.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
